Refresh a report's CITATION.cff for the version being built

Source: R/xct_cff.R
xct_cff_refresh.Rd

A report's CITATION.cff is the one record its citations come from. Its title and authors are written by hand; this function rewrites only what a build changes, so it can run at the end of every build:

Usage

xct_cff_refresh(
  path = "CITATION.cff",
  report_url,
  repo_url,
  desc = "DESCRIPTION",
  today = Sys.Date()
)

Arguments

path

character Path to the CITATION.cff to refresh. It must exist and carry a preferred-citation block.

report_url

character The URL the report is served at.

repo_url

character The URL of the report's source repository.

desc

character Path to the DESCRIPTION that holds Version and, optionally, Config/DOI.

today

Date The date to stamp. Defaults to Sys.Date().

Value

The refreshed record as a list, invisibly.

Details

  • date-released, and date-published and year in preferred-citation: the build date, because the version on the web is the one being dated;

  • version, at both levels: Version in DESCRIPTION, so a citation names the version it was made from as well as the date;

  • url and repository-code, at both levels;

  • doi, at both levels: Config/DOI in DESCRIPTION, when the repository is archived (a Zenodo concept DOI, for example).

The refreshed record must pass cffr::cff_validate() before it replaces path; otherwise nothing is written.

See also

Other cff: xct_bib_from_cff()

Examples

d <- tempfile("report_")
dir.create(d)
writeLines(c("Package: report", "Version: 0.2.0"), file.path(d, "DESCRIPTION"))
writeLines(c(
  "cff-version: 1.2.0",
  "message: If you use this report, please cite it as below.",
  "title: A report",
  "authors:",
  "- family-names: Irvine",
  "  given-names: Allan",
  "type: software",
  "preferred-citation:",
  "  type: report",
  "  title: A report",
  "  authors:",
  "  - family-names: Irvine",
  "    given-names: Allan",
  "  institution:",
  "    name: New Graph Environment Ltd.",
  "  year: 2024"
), file.path(d, "CITATION.cff"))
xct_cff_refresh(
  path = file.path(d, "CITATION.cff"),
  report_url = "https://www.example.com/a_report/",
  repo_url = "https://github.com/example/a_report",
  desc = file.path(d, "DESCRIPTION"),
  today = as.Date("2026-10-31")
)
#> /tmp/Rtmpuf7yBm/report_1a9d68f69f0a/CITATION.cff refreshed: version 0.2.0 dated 2026-10-31 (no DOI)
cat(readLines(file.path(d, "CITATION.cff")), sep = "\n")
#> cff-version: 1.2.0
#> message: If you use this report, please cite it as below.
#> title: A report
#> authors:
#> - family-names: Irvine
#>   given-names: Allan
#> type: software
#> preferred-citation:
#>   type: report
#>   title: A report
#>   authors:
#>   - family-names: Irvine
#>     given-names: Allan
#>   institution:
#>     name: New Graph Environment Ltd.
#>   year: 2026
#>   date-published: '2026-10-31'
#>   url: https://www.example.com/a_report/
#>   repository-code: https://github.com/example/a_report
#>   version: 0.2.0
#> date-released: '2026-10-31'
#> url: https://www.example.com/a_report/
#> repository-code: https://github.com/example/a_report
#> version: 0.2.0
